description: This file defines SparkListener event classes and the SparkListenerInterface trait for handling Spark scheduler events, including stage, task, job, executor, node, and application events, as well as a default no-op implementation of the listener.

classes.name: SparkListenerStageSubmitted
classes.description: Event class representing the submission of a Spark stage.

classes.name: SparkListenerStageCompleted
classes.description: Event class representing the completion of a Spark stage.

classes.name: SparkListenerTaskStart
classes.description: Event class for the start of a Spark task.

classes.name: SparkListenerTaskGettingResult
classes.description: Event class for a task beginning to fetch its result remotely.

classes.description: Event class for a submitted speculative task, with backward compatibility fields.

classes.description: Event class for the start of a Spark job, including stage info.
